scenes.narration: Before installing spaCR, choose an official distribution route. PyPI and conda-forge provide released packages, while GitHub provides source code, desktop installers, and release records.
scenes.speech_text: Before installing spacer, choose an official distribution route. [pype](/pˈIp/) and Conda Forge provide released packages, while [GitHub](/ɡˈɪthˌʌb/) provides source code, desktop installers, and release records.

scenes.narration: On PyPI, the release header shows the current stable version and the pip install spacr command.
scenes.speech_text: On [pype](/pˈIp/), the release header shows the current stable version and the pip install spacer command.

scenes.narration: The Project links section opens the documentation, homepage, issue tracker, and source repository.
scenes.speech_text: The Project links section opens the documentation, homepage, issue tracker, and source repository.

scenes.narration: On GitHub, use the branch selector to choose the source line. Main is the released line; nightly contains newer work still being tested.
scenes.speech_text: On [GitHub](/ɡˈɪthˌʌb/), use the branch selector to choose the source line. Main is the released line; nightly contains newer work still being tested.

scenes.narration: In a GitHub Release, expand Assets to download the Windows, macOS, or Linux installer, the Python package files, or the checksum list.
scenes.speech_text: In a [GitHub](/ɡˈɪthˌʌb/) Release, expand Assets to download the Windows, [macOS](/mˈækOˌɛs/), or Linux installer, the Python package files, or the checksum list.

scenes.narration: The official conda-forge package installs spaCR and its desktop dependencies into the active Conda environment. Use the exact command conda install conda-forge::spacr.
scenes.speech_text: The official Conda Forge package installs spacer and its desktop dependencies into the active Conda environment. Use the exact command conda install Conda Forge spacer.

scenes.narration: Use conda-forge or PyPI for a managed Python environment, GitHub Releases for a desktop installer, and nightly only when you need unreleased work. Next, choose the installation tutorial for your route.
scenes.speech_text: Use Conda Forge or [pype](/pˈIp/) for a managed Python environment, [GitHub](/ɡˈɪthˌʌb/) Releases for a desktop installer, and nightly only when you need unreleased work. Next, choose the installation tutorial for your route.
